Target files: packages/nodes-base/nodes/HighLevel/v2/GenericFunctions.ts, packages/nodes-base/nodes/HighLevel/v2/description/ContactDescription.ts, packages/nodes-base/nodes/HighLevel/v2/test/AddCustomFieldsPreSendAction.test.ts. Fixes NODE-5644 (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/41111)

workarounds.symptom: n8n node GET A WORKFLOW on localhost install FAILS when curl with same creds works
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: Normalize API base URL paths. Target files: packages/nodes-base/credentials/N8nApi.credentials.ts, packages/nodes-base/nodes/N8n/GenericFunctions.ts, packages/nodes-base/nodes/N8n/N8n.node.ts. Fixes NODE-5628 (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/41838)

workarounds.symptom: PostgreSQL connection pool becomes permanently congested after a DB proxy outage, blocking self-recovery
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): Release database ping connection when the health check times out. Target files: packages/@n8n/db/src/connection/db-connection-monitor.ts, packages/@n8n/db/src/connection/db-connection-options.ts, packages/@n8n/db/src/connection/__tests__/db-connection-monitor.recovery.postgres.test.ts. n8n can get stuck returning `503 Database is not ready` after a temporary PostgreSQL or database-proxy disruption. (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/32838)
